categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in steel manufacturing, including steel rolling and extrusion, secondary steel processing, steel smelting, casting, and metal product manufacturing. Key products include steel rebar, steel bars, wire rods, and steel billets. It also engages in metal recycling, international trade, and related engineering services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs integrated steelmaking and rolling processes, utilizing electric arc furnaces, refining furnaces, continuous casting machines, heating furnaces, and rolling mills. It focuses on process improvements such as nitrogen content control in special steels, oxygen blowing efficiency, automation in material feeding, and energy-saving measures including natural gas fuel conversion and optimized combustion control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include domestic and international construction companies, public infrastructure projects, mechanical manufacturing industries, and fastener manufacturers. The company serves both domestic markets across Taiwan and export markets including Australia, Hong Kong, and South Korea, with products used in building, automotive parts, hand tools, and machinery manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with sales distributed nationwide, increasingly expanding from southern to central and northern Taiwan. It also exports to key international markets such as Australia, Hong Kong, and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as an integrated steel producer covering upstream steel smelting and billet production, midstream rolling and processing, and downstream product sales. It controls raw material sourcing (scrap iron) and produces finished steel products for various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include increasing domestic market share for steel rebar and high value-added steel products, expanding international markets, and enhancing production efficiency through process improvements and energy-saving technologies. R&D focuses on special steel quality improvements, automation, carbon emission reduction, and product diversification to meet international standards and green certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of steel products including rebar, steel bars, wire rods, and billets. The company also earns income from secondary processing and international trade of steel products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a highly competitive steel industry affected by global overcapacity and low-priced imports, especially from China and Russia. It positions itself as a quality-focused integrated steel producer with diversified product offerings and international certifications, aiming to maintain stable profitability and expand market share domestically and abroad.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported year, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately NT$10.2 billion with a net profit of NT$316 million, reflecting a 24% decline in net profit compared to the previous year due to market challenges. The company has shown steady asset growth and maintains a balanced financial structure with liabilities at about 53% of assets. It plans to increase production capacity and invest in energy-saving equipment to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality, stable supply, and compliance with international standards including green steel certifications. Its integrated production process allows cost control and flexible product mix adjustments to meet diverse customer needs. The focus on energy efficiency and environmental sustainability differentiates its products as environmentally friendly steel solutions.
